Vendor comparisons usually end up in a spreadsheet that starts going stale the day it is made. Prices change, plan limits move, integrations disappear, and a confident AI answer may cite a page it never saw. VendorProof turns a messy procurement brief into a live evidence file with links that can be checked.

This run starts with a real buying brief: compare Intercom, Zendesk, and Crisp for a five-person support team. The brief includes a monthly budget, required capabilities, and deal breakers. It is not a chat question. It is the same kind of request a small team would hand to an operations lead before spending money.

After the form is submitted, Gemini extracts no more than five checks that could change the decision. VendorProof then searches Google web and Google News through SerpApi for each check. The production path has no canned search result. Every piece of evidence on the report comes from the live responses returned during this run.

Gemini proposes and evaluates the checks. SerpApi supplies current search results. A separate enforcement layer compares every citation with the exact URLs returned in this run. If a URL was not observed, it cannot appear as evidence. Xano stores the original brief and the complete report, so the browser never receives provider credentials.

This is a real result from the deployed app. The evidence file has a decision state, a confidence label, an explanation, a next action, and a clickable source. When a search channel fails or a citation is missing, VendorProof does not fill the gap with a guess. It downgrades the claim and can force the whole report into review or hold.

The Xano receipt shows snapshot forty-seven and the previous snapshot used for comparison. Xano normalizes the brief, serializes writes for the same brief, saves the full evidence JSON, and reports how many claims changed. The comparison is no longer a disposable answer. It has a history that another person can audit later.

The deployed version passed three hundred ninety-one tests, with branch-aware coverage above ninety-five percent. Secret scanning and push protection are enabled. An independent code review found no actionable regressions. The production smoke test completed the full Gemini, SerpApi, and Xano chain. VendorProof replaces a stale comparison sheet with current research and honest uncertainty. The live app and public source repository are available now. Evidence before commitment.
